id: 735-馬爾萬·伊本·穆罕默德入侵格魯吉亞
theater: 第比利斯城與庫拉河谷

battle.name: 馬爾萬·伊本·穆罕默德入侵格魯吉亞
battle.theater: 第比利斯城與庫拉河谷
battle.brief: 公元735年，倭馬亞王朝亞美尼亞總督馬爾萬·伊本·穆罕默德率大軍越過高加索，圍困卡爾特利首府第比利斯，圍城中使用投石機、撞槌與攻城塔，卡面的羅馬式投石機正是這類拋石器械的原型。圍城被可薩與喬治亞聯軍夜襲打斷，城市隨後仍落入馬爾萬手中，736年設置埃米爾統治。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在八世紀中葉的高加索，是倭馬亞哈里發國與卡爾特利、伊比里亞一帶基督教諸邦在裏海東岸的邊境衝突。哈里發希沙姆在位（724–743）期間，把亞美尼亞、亞塞拜然同卡爾特利一線的軍政交由總督（ostikan）節制，732 至 733 年間把總督之職交給馬爾萬·伊本·穆罕默德，因此 735 年越過高加索的大軍在名分上是哈里發國的西北邊軍，由亞美尼亞總督直接調度。兵源以阿拉伯騎兵為骨幹，雜有受招撫的亞美尼亞人、格魯吉亞逃兵與阿蘭部落的輔兵，攻城所需的重型器械由隨軍工匠隊與沿途徵發的匠人攜行，補給線則由多據點橫貫亞美尼亞與達爾班特一線維持。對面的卡爾特利王國以第比利斯為核心，國王瓦拉赫（即瓦赫坦格一世·哥爾加薩利）尚在少年時期，城防實務由城中的貴族長老與教會階層主持，軍力以步兵與格魯吉亞輕騎為主，欠缺攻城與遠程器械的技術。城外屏障則是可薩汗國，其主力是突厥式弓騎，麾下吸納阿蘭人與哥特人部眾，並與格魯吉亞人有軍事往來。圍城之後，哈里發國於 736 年在第比利斯另置埃米爾以取代原有的格魯吉亞官署，開啟第比利斯埃米爾國；同一時期的拜占庭帝國也從西側爭奪同一批城鎮與山口，是這場衝突的旁觀者兼潛在受益者。
countriesEn: This war was fought in the mid-eighth century in the Caucasus, and took the form of a frontier clash between the Umayyad Caliphate and the Christian polities of Kartli and neighbouring Iberia on the eastern Caspian littoral. During the reign of Caliph Hisham (724–743) the military and civil administration of the Armenian, Azerbaijanian and Kartlian lines was placed in the hands of the ostikan, and in 732–733 the caliph handed that governorship to Marwan ibn Muhammad; the army that crossed the Caucasus in 735 was therefore formally the northwest frontier army of the caliphate, mustered and directed by the governor of Armenia. Its backbone was Arab cavalry, supplemented by recruited Armenians, Georgian deserters and Alan auxiliaries, while the heavy siege equipment was carried by the corps of engineers and by conscripted artisans; the supply line ran through a chain of stations across Armenia and Derbend. Opposite them stood the Christian Kingdom of Kartli, centred on Tbilisi, whose king Valach — that is, Vakhtang I Gorgasali — was still a boy, with the actual defence of the city in the hands of the noble elders and the clergy; the field forces were mostly infantry and light Georgian horse, and they lacked the engineering and artillery skills that the siege demanded. Beyond the walls stood the Khazar Khaganate, whose warhorse was Turkic bow cavalry reinforced by Alan and Gothic contingents, and which was in active military contact with the Georgians. After the siege the caliphate replaced the Georgian administration of the city with an emir of its own in 736, opening the Emirate of Tbilisi; the Byzantine Empire, contesting the same Caucasian towns and passes from the western side of the range, watched the clash as a bystander and a potential beneficiary.
people: 阿軍的實際統帥是馬爾萬·伊本·穆罕默德，即後來的馬爾萬二世（約 691–750），倭馬亞王朝第十四位、也是最後一位哈里發。他是穆罕默德·伊本·馬爾萬之子、馬爾萬一世之孫、哈里發阿卜杜勒·馬利克之侄；732 至 733 年被希沙姆任命為亞美尼亞總督，735 至 736 年率軍越過高加索、蹂躪卡爾特利，攻取阿蘭人的三座要塞，並與阿蘭首領吐曼沙議和，739 至 740 年再入寇而取得貢賦；744 年他以年長宗親身分登上哈里發之位，750 年在扎卜河畔為阿拔斯派擊敗身亡，伍麥葉朝在呼羅珊以外的統治隨之崩解。格魯吉亞方面的關鍵人物是少年國王瓦拉赫，他的軍隊在圍城後期與可薩聯軍會合，並在 764 至 765 年最終逐走阿拉伯在卡爾特利的力量。可薩方面的解圍之師由汗國派出的將領率領，格魯吉亞編年史記其名為圖格里爾，並記他與國王同夜襲營。殉道者阿博（約 700–735/736）原為阿拉伯裔囚徒，囚於第比利斯，圍城中被釋後在街市公開傳教，隨即被捕、鞭打並釘死在城外，傳記由格魯吉亞教士約安·薩巴尼斯澤撰寫。另一位在相關事件中被囚於第比利斯的王族是聶爾斯，日後成為格魯吉亞教會大主教。
peopleEn: The effective commander of the Arab army was Marwan ibn Muhammad, the future Marwan II (c. 691–750), the fourteenth and last caliph of the Umayyad dynasty. He was the son of Muhammad ibn Marwan, a grandson of Caliph Marwan I and a nephew of Abd al-Malik; Hisham appointed him governor of Armenia in 732–733, and in 735–736 he led his army over the Caucasus, ravaged Kartli, took three Alan fortresses and made peace with the Alan leader Tumanshah, returning in 739–740 to exact tribute. In 744 he mounted the caliphate throne as the senior kinsman of the line, and on 6 August 750 he was defeated and killed by the Abbasids at the Zab, collapsing Umayyad rule east of Khurasan. On the Georgian side the key figure was the boy king Valach, whose troops joined the Khazar relief force late in the siege and who would finally expel the Arabs from Kartli in 764–765. The relieving Khazar host was led by a commander sent by the khagan, whom the Georgian chronicle names Tughril, and who is recorded as striking the besiegers' camp by night together with the king. The martyr of the siege was Abo (c. 700–735/736), an Arab-born captive who, freed during the siege, preached openly in the streets of Tbilisi, was arrested, scourged and crucified outside the walls; his passio was written down by the Georgian cleric Ioane Sabanisdze. Another royal captive in the city during these years was Prince Nerses, who later became Catholicos-Patriarch of Georgia.
kits: 卡面這具投石機（Onager）是公元前 3 世紀羅馬人的扭力式拋石機：把蓄在絞盤與扭力簧臂裡的勢能，經過長臂換成一塊飛石，射程數百步，是古代攻城從「撞門」走向「遠程拆毀」的門檻裝備。到了 735 年，古典英雄式投石機在歐亞軍中早已退場，中東與高加索的圍城者手裡是它的技術近親——拉索式投石車（mangonel，阿拉伯語 manjaniq，喬治亞語 მანგონელი），靠拉索與投臂的角速度把石彈甩出去，發射原理相近而機構更簡單；763 至 764 年阿拉伯人再圍第比利斯時，同樣攜帶大批這類器械。與投石機同行的還有攻城錘或撞槌：把覆皮槓頭懸掛在三角支架上，數十人推動撞向城門，專打木門與門閂；以及攻城塔與雲梯，把高台推到城牆下，掩體內的弓箭手與突擊隊依序登城。進攻武器是反曲弓、標槍、馬刀、長矛與短柄斧，騎兵用弓矛、步兵用長矛與盾，雙方都靠縱馬衝撞與散兵射擊爭奪城下的開闊地。防護方面有鱗甲、札甲與圓盾，攻城方用盾車與柳條筐（fascine）填壕、遮蔽接近路線。攻城並非只有器械：石彈要就地從河床與碎石堆採集，木料需砍伐新城牆外一片的樹木，柴薪、飼料、水源都要靠騎兵深入格魯吉亞山區去取得，器械本身也要靠牛車與駱駝隊搬運。
kitsEn: The onager on the card is the Roman torsion stone-thrower of the third century BCE: it took the potential stored in a winch and a torsion bundle and turned it, through a long arm, into a flying stone, throwing for several hundred paces, and it was the threshold equipment that carried ancient siegecraft from battering the gate to destroying works at range. By 735 the classical heroic stone-thrower had long left the armies of Eurasia, and what the besiegers of the Caucasus actually carried was its technical kinsman, the traction trebuchet or mangonel (Arabic manjaniq, Georgian მანგონელი), which whipped a stone out of the throwing arm by the speed of the traction rope; the working principle is the same, the mechanism simpler. The Arabs who besieged Tbilisi again in 763–764 brought large numbers of the same class of machine. Beside the stone-throwers came the battering ram, a hide-covered ram head slung from a triangular frame and pushed by several dozen men against gates, doors and bolts, and siege towers and ladders, which were brought up to the walls so that archers and assault teams inside the covered platform could climb in turn. The assault weapons were composite bows, javelins, sabres, spears and short-handled axes; cavalry fought with bow and lance, infantry with spear and shield, and both sides fought for the open ground below the walls with charge and loose shooting. Protection came from scale and lamellar armour and round shields, while the besiegers used shielded wagons and willow fascines to fill the ditch and cover their approach. Siege was never only about machines: the stones had to be gathered from the riverbed and rubble heaps on the spot, timber had to be cut from the woods just outside the new wall line, and firewood, fodder and water had to be fetched by horsemen deep into the Georgian highlands, with the machines themselves hauled by ox carts and camel trains.
tactics: 這場圍城是典型的斷糧式攻城，而非一次會戰。阿軍先以大隊騎兵封鎖通往卡爾特利山區的道路、渡口與驛路，迫使城內糧價騰貴、援軍斷絕；同時把營地設在能同時控制水源與牧場的位置，靠徵發維持數月遠征的給養。投石機在這套系統裡負責壓制城頭：石彈射程有限，必須在距城牆數百米內的陣地架設，因此推進到能看清城門的距離本身就是最危險的一段；石彈飛向城堞與塔樓，使守軍不敢在牆頭久留，弓弩手無法自由射擊。進攻序列是分段的：先用石彈與弓箭清空城頭，再用盾車與填壕柴束鋪平壕溝，撞槌抵近城門，最後以雲梯分批登城，避免一次投入太多兵力；每一步都靠投石機的火力掩護推進。守方的對策是把城牆分段、讓塔樓之間互為射界，用出擊與縱火燒毀接近的器械，並在夜裡出城襲擾營壘。破局的是可薩與格魯吉亞聯軍的夜襲：聯軍趁夜色接近營地，以騎兵衝散哨戒與器械操作人員，圍軍失去攻勢，被迫撤退。同一套攻城邏輯在 763 至 764 年的第二次第比利斯之圍再度重演，那一次格魯吉亞人同樣靠夜襲摧毀攻城器械而解圍。
tacticsEn: This siege followed the logic of a blockade rather than of a pitched battle. The Arab host first sealed the roads into the Kartlian highlands, the fords and the posting roads with large bodies of horse, so that prices inside the city rose and relief could no longer arrive; at the same time the camp was pitched where it could hold both the water and the pastures, and the host lived for months on requisition. Within that system the stone-throwers did the work of suppression: their reach was short, so they had to be set up within a few hundred metres of the wall, and pushing forward to a point where the gates could be seen was itself the most dangerous stretch of the operation; the stones flew at the battlements and towers, keeping the defenders from lingering on the parapet and stopping the archers from shooting freely. The assault was staged in instalments: first stones and arrows to clear the wall-head, then shielded wagons and fascines to level the ditch, then the rams brought up to the gates, and finally ladders put up in successive parties rather than committing everything at once, each step covered by the stone-throwers. The defenders replied by dividing the curtain into sections so that the towers covered one another, by sorties and fire to burn the machines that came too close, and by night sorties against the camp. What broke the siege was a night attack by the combined Khazar-Georgian host: the allied horse closed on the camp in the dark, scattered the pickets and the crews serving the engines, and the besiegers, deprived of their offensive, withdrew. The same siege logic was repeated in the second siege of Tbilisi in 763–764, when the Georgians again destroyed the engines by night and the siege was lifted.
data: 兵力方面，格魯吉亞編年史把阿軍記為數萬之眾，不同抄本或作三萬、或作六萬，並記其中有大批騎兵；阿拉伯系史料則不提具體人數，現代學者多視編年史數字為誇大，認為實際出動規模遠小於此。可薩與格魯吉亞聯軍的總數沒有可靠記載。圍城歷時數月，編年史只說「久」而沒有確數，本卡依夏末戰役季的通行排序標為七月。攻城器械方面，近代復原研究把這類扭力與拉索式拋石機的射程量在數百米，石彈在數十公斤量級；因射程短而石彈消耗大，每次齊射後都需就地補彈，軍中必然配備採石與運石的人手，圍城者也要為營帳、槓桿、繩索與備件配給車隊。城市方面，第比利斯有雙重城牆與三座城門，橫跨庫拉河兩岸，兩部分以浮橋相連，城內有水磨與溫泉，房屋多以松木為骨架；阿拉伯地理家記九世紀上半期此城人口至少五萬，是高加索僅次於德爾本德的第二大城，可作圍攻當時城市規模的參照。役後的追擊段落還記有阿軍深入阿蘭人山地，攻下三座要塞。
dataEn: On numbers, the Georgian chronicle records the Arab host as tens of thousands, with one manuscript giving thirty thousand and another sixty thousand and noting many horsemen; the Arabic sources give no figure, and modern scholars generally treat the chronicle numbers as an exaggeration, holding the real expedition to have been much smaller. No reliable figure survives for the Khazar-Georgian relief force. The siege lasted a number of months; the chronicle says only that it was long and gives no exact figure, and this card marks it as July on the usual ordering of the late-summer campaign season. On the machines, modern reconstruction work puts the range of torsion and traction stone-throwers in the hundreds of metres and the stone in the tens of kilograms; because the reach is short and the ammunition bulky, fresh stones had to be brought up after each salvo, and the besiegers needed men and draught animals assigned to quarrying and carrying them, together with wagons for tent frames, beams, ropes and spare parts. On the city, Tbilisi had a double wall pierced by three gates, lay on both banks of the Kura with the two halves joined by a bridge of boats, and had water-mills and hot springs inside, its houses built largely of pine; Arab geographers put its population at no fewer than fifty thousand in the first half of the ninth century, making it the second city of the Caucasus after Derbend, and this is the best available reference for the size of the city when it was invested. The campaigning that followed the siege is also recorded: the Arab host pushed into the Alan highlands and took three fortresses.
cause: 根本原因在於倭馬亞朝西北邊疆與可薩汗國之間長達半個世紀的消耗戰。阿拉伯人自 645 年前後已進入卡爾特利，此後數十年逐步向北推進，壯丁徵發與年稅都靠這一線；到八世紀，雙方在亞美尼亞、高加索山脈與達里亞爾山口一線反覆拉鋸，爭的是同一條通道：從裏海東岸經過卡爾特利通往北方草原的商路與牧場，也是阿軍深入北方與北方勢力南下的咽喉。可薩汗國在 730 年前後曾越過高加索、深入劫掠亞美尼亞與亞塞拜然，約 737 至 738 年的「可薩汗回信」正是對這類遠征的回應，記中提到可薩人自北方南下、以及與阿拉伯人接戰的過程。哈里發希沙姆把亞美尼亞總督之職交給馬爾萬，任務正是向北推進、把可薩與阿蘭壓回草原，並把卡爾特利變成可徵稅的屬地；734 年前後大軍集結、越過山口的直接導火線，則是格魯吉亞王權更替與地方貴族的矛盾、以及可薩系部眾在境內的膨脹。圍城本身還有一層宗教與王朝的名義：把基督教城邑納入哈里發版圖，等於把這條邊界固定下來。
causeEn: The root cause lay in a half-century of attrition between the northwest frontier of the Umayyad caliphate and the Khazar Khaganate. The Arabs had entered Kartli by about 645, and over the following decades pushed steadily north, drawing levies and annual tribute from that line; by the eighth century the two powers were contesting the same corridor in Armenia, along the Caucasian range and through the Darial Pass — the trade road and pasture route from the eastern Caspian into Kartli and northward, and the throat through which the caliphate's armies advanced and the northern powers came down. Around 730 the Khazar Khaganate crossed the Caucasus and raided deep into Armenia and Azerbaijan; the so-called Letter of the Khazar Khagan, dated to about 737–738, is the reply to such raids and recalls the Khazar move south and the fighting with the Arabs. Hisham's decision to place the governorship of Armenia in Marwan's hands was aimed precisely at pushing north, driving the Khazars and the Alans back to the steppe and turning Kartli into a taxable dependency. The immediate spark in 734, when the host was mustered and the passes crossed, was the change of kings in Georgia and the quarrel of the local aristocracy, together with the swelling of Khazar-affected elements inside the country. The siege had a religious and dynastic logic as well: to bring a Christian city inside the caliphate's frontiers was to fix that frontier once and for all.
impact: 最直接的後果是第比利斯埃米爾國的建立。阿拉伯人於 736 年在城中設置埃米爾，由哈里發或亞美尼亞總督確認，埃米爾國延續到 1080 年，格魯吉亞方面則認為要到 1122 年亞歷山大四世收復最後一位埃米爾才算結束。在這段近四百年的分裂期裡，第比利斯從一座山間要塞變成裏海與黑海之間的商路樞紐，穆斯林社群、波斯與阿拉伯商人、手藝人與學者湧入，城市伊斯蘭化，但城外的高加索腹地大致仍屬基督徒，於是出現了城內清真寺與城外修道院並存的格局。聖阿博的殉道被格魯吉亞教會寫成抵抗的聖徒傳說，成為日後王權對抗阿拉伯宗主、爭取教會獨立的道德資源。技術與知識層面，攻城機的引進與阿拉伯世界在造紙、冶金、醫藥方面的傳入，使卡爾特利受益，也讓格魯吉亞得以在同一條線上學習反制。更大的遠期影響來自馬爾萬本人的結局：這場勝利把他推向 744 年的哈里發之位，750 年扎卜河的敗亡使伍麥葉朝在呼羅珊以外全面崩解，第比利斯埃米爾國改隸巴格達，阿拉伯的西北邊疆隨之收縮，格魯吉亞在八至九世紀逐步取得實質獨立。
impactEn: The most direct consequence was the creation of the Emirate of Tbilisi. In 736 the Arabs installed an emir in the city, confirmed by the caliph or by the ostikan of Armenia; the emirate ran until 1080, while the Georgians dated the end of Arab rule to 1122, when David IV of Georgia drove out the last emir. Across nearly four centuries of this divided period Tbilisi changed from a mountain fortress into a hinge of the trade routes between the Caspian and the Black Sea: Muslim communities, Persian and Arab merchants, craftsmen and scholars poured in, the city was Islamised, and yet the Caucasian hinterland remained largely Christian, so that mosques inside the walls stood side by side with monasteries outside them. Abo's martyrdom was written up by the Georgian church as a saint's legend of resistance, and became the moral resource of a later kingship struggling against Arab suzerainty for the independence of the Georgian church. On the technical level the introduction of siege engines, together with the transmission of paper-making, metallurgy and medicine from the Arab world, benefited Kartli, while at the same time teaching the Georgians how to counter them. The larger long-term effect came from Marwan's own end: this victory carried him to the caliphate in 744, and his defeat at the Zab in 750 dissolved Umayyad rule east of Khurasan; the Emirate of Tbilisi passed to the Abbasid caliphs, the northwest frontier contracted, and Georgia won a de facto independence over the course of the eighth and ninth centuries.
result: 依格魯吉亞編年史（《Kartlis I》）與聖阿博殉道記，阿拉伯大軍在第比利斯城下受阻，石彈與撞槌未能摧毀城防，圍城在數月之後因可薩與格魯吉亞聯軍夜襲營地而中斷，圍軍撤退，格魯吉亞一時以此為大捷，聖阿博也正是在這段圍城期內殉道。阿拉伯系史料的說法不同：馬爾萬在 735 年控制了第比利斯及周邊地區，736 年設置埃米爾，此後卡爾特利在形式上成為哈里發國的屬地；馬爾萬又在 735 至 736 年間攻取阿蘭人的三座要塞，並與吐曼沙議和，739 至 740 年再度入寇而取得貢賦。兩種記述並非完全互斥：圍城確實慘烈進行並以阿軍在卡爾特利站穩腳跟收場，但城市在戰役結束後立即落入馬爾萬的掌握，第比利斯埃米爾國由此開始，之後歷經阿拔斯朝的確認與承認，直到 1080 年喬治亞王亞歷山大四世逐步收復、1122 年末代埃米爾出逃。對雙方而言，這場戰爭都沒有取得決定性成果：阿軍未能在北方站穩，格魯吉亞也未能在 735 年脫離哈里發體系，真正的清算要等到 764 至 765 年的第比利斯之戰。
resultEn: According to the Georgian chronicle (Kartlis I) and the Martyrdom of Abo of Tiflis, the Arab army was checked before Tbilisi: neither the stones nor the rams could break the defences, and after some months the siege was broken when a combined Khazar-Georgian host attacked the camp by night and the besiegers withdrew, which the Georgians counted at the time as a great deliverance; it was during this siege that Abo was martyred. The Arabic sources tell it differently: Marwan took Tbilisi and its surroundings in 735, set up an emir there in 736, and Kartli became in form a dependency of the caliphate; between 735 and 736 he also took three Alan fortresses and made peace with Tumanshah, and in 739–740 he came back once more for tribute. The two accounts are not necessarily exclusive: the siege was fought hard and ended with the Arab army in possession of Kartli, but the city passed at once into Marwan's hands, the Emirate of Tbilisi began there, and it went on to be confirmed and recognised by the Abbasids until David IV of Georgia recovered it step by step in 1080 and the last emir fled in 1122. For both sides the war settled nothing decisive: the Arabs could not hold the north, and the Georgians did not escape the caliphate's system in 735. The real reckoning came with the battle for Tbilisi in 764–765.
